site.storeLabel: Download Macdio on the App Store

guides.title: Macdio Guides: How to Use Macdio and Internet Radio
guides.description: How to use every Macdio feature on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch, plus practical answers about internet radio, written by the developer.
guides.intro: How to use Macdio, one feature at a time, and short practical answers to the questions internet radio listeners ask, written by the developer of Macdio. Each guide names the devices it applies to and ends with the questions people search for.
guides.behind: Macdio is a native internet radio and podcast player for iPhone, Mac, Apple TV, iPad and Apple Watch. 60,000+ stations, recording, live lyrics and microphone-free song identification, in one purchase with no subscription.
guides.writtenBy: Written by Sait Firat NEMIS, the developer of Macdio.

guides.label: Macdio on iPhone and iPad
guides.title: Macdio on iPhone and iPad
guides.description: Find your way around Macdio on iPhone and iPad: the tabs and Settings, the mini and full player, Clock Mode and its alarm, widgets, the Lock Screen and CarPlay.

guides.label: Macdio on the Mac
guides.title: Macdio on the Mac
guides.description: How Macdio works on a Mac: the main window, the player panel, the compact player, the menu bar player, the Dock menu, keyboard shortcuts and Settings.

guides.label: Macdio on Apple TV
guides.title: Macdio on Apple TV
guides.description: How Macdio works on Apple TV: tabs, the Siri Remote, Now Playing and the ambient screen, Top Shelf rows, synced transcripts and adding stations from a computer.

guides.label: Add your own station
guides.title: How to add your own station by stream URL
guides.description: Add any internet radio stream to Macdio by its address on iPhone, iPad or Mac, test it, give it a logo, then edit or delete it. Apple TV uses a browser.

guides.label: Edit stations on a computer
guides.title: Edit your stations from a computer browser
guides.description: Edit on Computer opens your own Macdio stations in a browser on the same Wi-Fi, from iPhone, iPad or Apple TV. Add, edit, import and export JSON, CSV or M3U.

guides.label: Favorites, lists and sync
guides.title: Favorites, lists and iCloud sync
guides.description: How favorites, My Stations and your own lists work in Macdio, how to set their order, and what iCloud syncs between your iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.

guides.label: Song ID and Auto Shazam
guides.title: Song ID and Auto Shazam in Macdio
guides.description: How Song ID and Auto Shazam name the song a station is playing in Macdio on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch, and where those songs go next.

guides.label: Record a station
guides.title: How to record radio in Macdio
guides.description: Record any station in Macdio on iPhone, iPad and Mac: start and stop, one file or one file per song, length and disk limits, and where your recordings are kept.

guides.label: Sleep timer and Clock Mode
guides.title: Sleep timer and Clock Mode
guides.description: Set a sleep timer in Macdio on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch, bring it back with Repeat Timer, and use Clock Mode on iPhone as a bedside alarm.

guides.label: Podcasts in Macdio
guides.title: Follow, queue and download podcasts
guides.description: Follow podcasts by search, chart, feed URL or OPML, queue episodes and live radio together in Up Next, download for offline, and set speed on each device.

guides.label: Transcripts and Highlights
guides.title: Transcripts, chapters and Highlights
guides.description: Macdio writes podcast transcripts on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Search inside episodes, mark a sentence by tap or Siri, and send it to Notes, Notion or Readwise.

guides.label: Shortcuts and automations
guides.title: Shortcuts actions and automations
guides.description: All nine Macdio actions in Apple's Shortcuts app, what each one does, and automations that start a station at 7:00 or play the newest podcast episode.

guides.label: AirPods and headphones
guides.title: AirPods and headphone controls
guides.description: What a single, double and triple press on AirPods or headphones does in Macdio, for live radio and for podcasts, plus Live Pause and the Mac media keys.

guides.label: Game controllers
guides.title: Use a game controller
guides.description: Play, pause, switch stations and browse your radio and podcasts in Macdio with a DualSense, Xbox or Backbone controller, and remap every button on iPhone.

guides.label: Customize Macdio
guides.title: Settings worth changing
guides.description: The Macdio settings worth changing on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV: dark mode, app icon, tab bar, Library sections, Live Pause, the Dock and the menu bar.

guides.label: Radio on a Mac
guides.title: How to listen to internet radio on a Mac
guides.description: Browser, VLC, the Music app or a menu bar player: every route, with honest trade-offs. Read this one first if you are new to radio on the desktop.

guides.label: Apple Watch without an iPhone
guides.title: Radio on Apple Watch without an iPhone
guides.description: Streaming on the wrist with no iPhone nearby: what standalone really means, what you need, and honest battery numbers.

guides.label: Radio in CarPlay
guides.title: Internet radio on CarPlay
guides.description: Presets like a classic car stereo, worldwide stations instead of local FM, and what a long drive costs in mobile data.

guides.label: Play radio with Siri
guides.title: Play radio with Siri
guides.description: Every voice phrase Macdio understands, in 14 languages, and how a station name spoken in the car turns into the right stream.

guides.label: Record internet radio
guides.title: How to record internet radio
guides.description: Turn a live show into named, individual tracks on Mac and iPhone, and where the law of personal recording actually stands.

guides.label: What song is playing?
guides.title: What song is playing on the radio?
guides.description: Three ways to identify a radio song, including one that reads the stream itself and never asks for the microphone.

guides.label: Find a stream URL
guides.title: How to find a station's stream URL
guides.description: Four ways to get the direct address, what you may do with it, and how to add a station of your own.

guides.label: Does the iPhone have FM radio?
guides.title: Does the iPhone have FM radio?
guides.description: The honest answer about the missing chip, receiver against transmitter, the emergency argument, and what to do instead.

guides.label: Best internet radio apps
guides.title: Best internet radio apps compared
guides.description: Seven players for Mac, iPhone, Apple Watch and Apple TV, with prices, station counts and what each one leaves out.
